shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,300p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && rg -n \"beforeSession|afterSession|onError\" src specs CHANGELOG* package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log --oneline -6 && sed -n '1,440p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,90p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md && rg -n \"specs/.+#|@spec|spec:\" src --glob '*test.ts' | head -80 && rg --files scripts | rg 'spec-links|lore'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs 'src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts::ChatOrchestrator hooks beforeSession notifies onError and ends the session when it throws'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs 'src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts::ChatOrchestrator hooks beforeSession notifies onError and ends the session when it throws'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs 'src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts::ChatOrchestrator hooks beforeSession notifies onError and ends the session when it throws' && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t '"'^ChatOrchestrator hooks beforeSession notifies onError and ends the session when it throws$'"' --coverage=false && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && git commit -m 'fix: handle beforeSession hook failures' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch"
